meta.description: Catering for weddings, birthdays and celebrations. Buffets, tailored menus and homemade yogurts. Get a quote on WhatsApp.

home.heroText: We prepare your buffets and menus with care, so you can enjoy your guests.
heroAlts: Wedding buffet set up by BKJ service
Birthday table with cake and decoration
Signature dishes prepared for a family celebration

phrases: Tell us the date, we'll handle the rest.

sections.servicesIntro: From a grand wedding to an intimate birthday, we build the menu, the service and the setup together with you.
servicesTexts: Civil, traditional or religious: a buffet worthy of the big day, designed with you.
For kids and adults: buffet, cake and table decoration.
Baptisms, reunions, seminars, openings: we adapt to your event.

servicesPage.title: Our catering services
servicesPage.intro: Weddings, birthdays, family parties or corporate events: pick your occasion and we take care of the rest.
servicesPage.closingTitle: Your event doesn't fit any box?
servicesPage.closingText: Describe your project and we will build it to measure.

menusPage.title: Menus and packages
menusPage.intro: Three packages to start with, which we adapt to your event, your tastes and your guests.
menusPage.pricingNote: Every event is different: number of guests, venue, date, menu and type of service. We prepare a personalized quote and discuss it together on WhatsApp.
menusPage.noResult: No package matches these filters. Try others, or request a tailor-made quote.
menusPage.shareMessage: Check out the {name} package from BKJ service:
menusPage.extrasIntro: Add what you need to any package.
menusPage.dietsText: Vegetarian, pork-free or any other restriction: mention it in your request and we adapt the menu. Please also tell us about your guests' allergies, it matters for their safety.
menusPage.closingText: Tell us the date and the number of guests: we get back to you on WhatsApp.

yogurtsPage.title: Yaourt na biso
yogurtsPage.intro: Our strawberry yogurts, in two sizes, for everyday and for your events.
yogurtsPage.orderIntro: Choose your quantities. Nothing is paid online: you finalize with us on WhatsApp.
yogurtsPage.eventHint: For large quantities or individual cups, please request a quote instead.
yogurtsPage.orderNote: A message is pre-filled: you just have to send it.
yogurtsPage.msgHello: Hello BKJ service, I would like to order yogurts:
yogurtsPage.deliveryText: Details are confirmed with you on WhatsApp, depending on your area.
yogurtsPage.closingText: Birthday, wedding, seminar: we prepare large quantities on request.
